subject: Marketplace listing playbook sync — Stratus co-sell eligibility
messages:
From: Maya Rehman <maya.rehman@stratus-int.com>

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro & marketplace listing + co-sell question

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Stratus Integrations is finalizing our partnership package and we want to be sure we meet Redwood's marketplace and co-sell requirements for AWS and GCP. High level asks:

- What are the minimum listing artifacts Redwood needs for each marketplace (AWS, GCP, Azure)?
- Is there a Redwood-specific co-sell qualification (e.g., solution brief + reference customer) before Redwood can nominate a partner to AWS team?
- Who should own the marketplace publisher onboarding vs. co-sell enablement?

We have a preliminary technical brief and a short customer case (pdfs) — happy to share. Can we set a 30-minute sync early next week to walk through the playbook and expected timelines?

Best,
Maya Rehman
Head of Alliances, Stratus Integrations
Attachments: stratus-technical-brief.pdf, stratus-customer-case-2026.pdf

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Maya Rehman <maya.rehman@stratus-int.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & marketplace listing + co-sell question

Hi Maya — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the materials; skimmed them and they look promising.

Quick answers up front:
1) Listing artifacts: catalog tile copy, 1–2 technical screenshots, tested deployment notes (marketplace-specific), security posture doc (SOC2/iso statements), and a contact for transact/billing. I attached our internal checklist for marketplace ops to this thread.
2) Co-sell qualification: we typically require a joint solution brief + one reference customer willing to participate in a joint engagement or pilot. For AWS co-sell nomination we also ask for a short sales play (partners sometimes submit a 1-pager).
3) Ownership: Stratus should own the publisher onboarding (you control the listing), Redwood will drive co-sell enablement (sales play + account motion) and help with nomination once eligibility is met.

Can you do Tues 10/7 10:00 PT? Vanessa will join from our marketplace ops side and Marissa will cover partner GTM readiness.

K

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-marketplace-listing-checklist.pdf

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-10-06T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro & marketplace listing + co-sell question

Thanks all — adding some ops-level detail ahead of the call so it's actionable:

- Required artifacts by marketplace (short):
  * AWS: Architecture diagram, AMI/container image details, cloud formation/terraform notes (if available), contact for billing, security checklist (SOC2 + encryption in transit/at rest).
  * GCP: Verified container registry, GCP Marketplace compatible config, support email, security attestation.
  * Azure: ARM template or ARM/Microsoft Marketplace packaging notes, offer listing owner identity.

- Timeline: From submission to publish typically 4–8 weeks (depends on vendor readiness and marketplace QA). Co-sell nomination can be requested after listing is approved and we have an approved joint solution brief and reference contact.

- Doc requests: Please share the Stratus MSA redlines so legal can triage in parallel. We often surface a billing contact mismatch early — include that contact in your marketplace form.

See attached: stratus-listing-checklist.pdf (filled with our initial notes)

Vanessa
Head of Marketplace Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: stratus-listing-checklist.pdf
